description: This file defines logging-related classes, functions, and macros for the WPEFramework project, including a template class for logging categories, external functions for dumping exceptions and system files, and macros for logging control and messaging.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class for logging categories, providing static methods to control and query logging status, and access metadata.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: External function to dump exception details based on exception type.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: External function to dump system files for a given process ID.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Static method to announce logging availability.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Static method to check if logging is enabled.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Static method to enable or disable logging.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Static method to retrieve logging metadata.
